title: What Is Herniated Disc Surgery? A Guide for Patients
description: What herniated disc surgery (discectomy/microdiscectomy) is, what it is for and when it is recommended. Care in Lima with price alternatives.
tldr: It treats a herniated disc that compresses a nerve and causes pain, tingling or weakness, when it does not improve with conservative treatment. The specialist decides the indication; results vary from person to person.
bodyHtml:
It treats a herniated disc that compresses a nerve and causes pain, tingling or weakness, when it does not improve with conservative treatment.

How is it done?

Microdiscectomy or endoscopic techniques that remove the fragment compressing the nerve.

When is it recommended?

A herniation with disabling pain or a neurological deficit that does not improve with conservative treatment. The specialist decides.

At Cirugía 24 Horas

We operate in Lima with the same team across different clinics, so you can choose the price alternative that fits you. We also care for patients from abroad.

tldr: Like any surgery, herniated disc surgery has risks: infection, fluid leak, recurrence of the herniation and, rarely, nerve injury. They are uncommon and are reduced with proper evaluation, careful technique and follow-up. The surgeon explains them during the consultation.
bodyHtml:
Learning about the risks of herniated disc surgery is part of making a responsible decision.

Possible complications

Infection, fluid leak, recurrence of the herniation and, rarely, nerve injury.

How they are reduced

A complete pre-operative evaluation, careful technique and close follow-up. The team's experience influences results.

faqs.a: It is a common procedure; safety depends on the evaluation, the technique and the follow-up.
